items.title: General Electric (GE) Engine Delays Threaten Year End Fighter Delivery Target
items.summary: General Electric (NYSE:GE) Aerospace is experiencing continued delivery issues for its F404-IN20 engines for the HAL Tejas Mk1A fighter program. The production challenges have created a sizeable backlog of Tejas Mk1A engine orders that remain undelivered as of November 19, 2026. These delays mean GE Aerospace now risks missing the previously targeted year end schedule for supplying engines to the Indian fighter fleet.
